description: A green placemat sits on a pink surface with yellow and blue plastic dishes, cups, and utensils arranged on top. The right hand clears the blue place setting by lifting and moving the blue plate to the left and setting the blue cup onto it, then gathers the blue spoon, fork, and knife and places them into the blue cup; next it lifts the yellow plate and cup to the left and tucks the yellow fork and spoon into the yellow cup, and finally both hands grab the green placemat, pull it inward, fold it neatly, and lift it up together.
